reasoning_content: Now let me pull and rebuild on VPS.

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")

# Pull and rebuild
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("cd /opt/areloria && git pull origin main && cd server && pnpm run build 2>&1 | tail -10")
print("Build:", stdout.read().decode())

# Restart PM2
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("pm2 restart areloria && sleep 8")
print("\nRestarted")

# Check port
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("ss -tlnp | grep node")
print("\nPorts:", stdout.read().decode())

client.close()
EOF
